item.title: X 早报 · 2026-11-13（周五）
item.content:encoded:
X 早报 · 2026-11-13（周五）

概览

英伟达黄仁勋辞职风波继续发酵：CNN 援引多位情报界人士称，现有情报不足以证明 Alice Huang 是中国间谍，「间谍」说法被指言过其实；特朗普表示若她不是间谍「情况也许就不一样」，参议院银行委员会已传唤黄仁勋和商务部长 Lutnick 作证。英伟达内部要求黄仁勋复职的帖子收到 1600 多条评论，网上投票逾九成支持他留任；散户三天买入 16 亿美元英伟达股票逆势抄底，多位分析师则担心后黄仁勋时代英伟达对新云厂商的扶持和大胆押注会减弱。宏观方面，10 月 PPI 同比升至 6.5%，为 2022 年 11 月以来最高，市场押注 12 月加息，美银预计接下来三次会议都将加息；美国 10 月预算赤字 4040 亿美元创同期纪录。比特币跌破 6.9 万美元，加密市场 48 小时蒸发 1500 亿美元。科技方面，微软 365 全球宕机超 16 小时；三星洽谈收购散热厂商 Modine，CoreWeave 寻求以 Meta 合同担保的 40 亿美元贷款；SpaceX 星舰第 15 次试飞尝试首次两级全回收。

英伟达：黄仁勋辞职余波

Naval (@naval)

黄仁勋就是英伟达的史蒂夫·乔布斯。他无可替代。

原文：Jensen Huang is the Steve Jobs of Nvidia. He is irreplaceable .

❤ 32,959 · 原帖

The Kobeissi Letter (@KobeissiLetter)

突发：据《连线》（WIRED）报道，英伟达（$NVDA）内部一篇敦促董事会让黄仁勋复职的帖子已收到超过 1600 条评论，其中多数表示「完全支持」让他回归。
该帖子敦促董事会就黄仁勋离职一事「考虑员工的感受」。

原文：BREAKING: An internal post urging Nvidia’s, $NVDA, board to reinstate Jensen Huang has drawn over 1,600 comments, with the majority in “full support” of reinstating him, per WIRED.
The post urges the Board of Directors to “consider employee sentiment” regarding Jensen Huang’s departure from the company.

❤ 11,527 · 原帖

The Kobeissi Letter (@KobeissiLetter)

突发：据 CNN 报道，美国情报界多位消息人士表示，针对 Alice Huang（涉嫌针对黄仁勋的间谍）所收集的情报，并不能证明她是在为中国从事间谍活动。
国家情报总监办公室的一些官员表示，将 Alice Huang 定性为中国间谍「并不完全准确，而且言过其实」。
中情局官员也「尚未被说服」，认为迄今为止对 Alice Huang 的情报收集（包括截获的通讯）还不能证明她是在有意向北京输送情报。
据报道，联邦调查局对此事的调查已至少持续了一年。
我们坚持认为，黄仁勋与英伟达分道扬镳为时过早。
有必要进行全面调查。

原文：BREAKING: Multiple sources in the US intelligence community say that the intelligence collected on Alice Huang, the suspected spy targeting Jensen Huang, does not prove she was acting as a spy for China, per CNN.
Some officials at the Office of the Director of National Intelligence have said the characterization of Alice Huang as a Chinese spy is "not entirely accurate and over-torqued."
Officials at the CIA also are "not yet convinced" that the intelligence collection on Alice Huang so far, including intercepted communications, proves she was knowingly funneling information back to Beijing.
The FBI has reportedly been investigating this affair for at least a year.
We maintain our view that Jensen Huang and Nvidia prematurely parted ways.
A complete investigation is necessary.

❤ 9,707 · 原帖

Wall St Engine (@wallstengine)

多位消息人士告诉 CNN，美国情报官员并不确信这位处于英伟达丑闻中心的女子是在为中国从事间谍活动，尽管这一指控已经让黄仁勋丢掉了工作。
国家情报总监办公室的官员称，「间谍」这一标签「并不完全准确，而且言过其实」。中情局官员也不确定截获的通讯能否表明她在有意向北京传递情报。
司法部长 Todd Blanche 周四表示，关于她是什么人、不是什么人，目前尚未得出任何结论；特朗普也表示，他不知道是否已认定她是间谍。
其他特朗普政府官员仍认为她构成反情报风险，因为她能接触到黄仁勋，并通过黄仁勋接触到总统。
注：联邦调查局已调查至少一年，对她从中国官方电视台记者转身成为拥有巨大芯片采购能力的女商人一事心存怀疑。她在新加坡的公司 Megaspeed 自 2024 年起就因涉嫌将受限芯片转运至中国而受到美国调查。

原文：US intelligence officials are NOT convinced the woman at the center of the Nvidia scandal was spying for China, multiple sources told CNN, even though the allegation has already cost Jensen Huang his job.
Officials at the Office of the Director of National Intelligence called the spy label "not entirely accurate and over-torqued." CIA officials are not yet sure that intercepted communications show she knowingly passed information to Beijing.
Attorney General Todd Blanche said Thursday that no conclusions have been reached about who she is or is not, and Trump said he did not know whether it had been determined she was a spy.
Other Trump officials still regard her as a counterintelligence risk, given her access to Huang and, through him, to the president.
Note: The FBI has been investigating for at least a year and is suspicious of her switch from Chinese state TV journalist to a businesswoman with large chip-buying power. Her Singapore-based firm Megaspeed has been under a US probe since 2024 over suspected diversion of restricted chips to China.

❤ 249 · 原帖

Wall St Engine (@wallstengine)

据彭博社报道，黄仁勋担任英伟达 CEO 的最后几个小时：
> 董事会开会到深夜，让他别无选择，只能辞职
>
> 他看上去心力交瘁，往日雷厉风行的作风荡然无存
> 开始说「随便吧」「我无所谓」之类的话
> 此后他称自己是个「混蛋」
> 他说自己已不在乎会发生什么
> 他最关心的是妻子，以及不要「毁掉」如今与他牵扯在一起的那些女性的生活

原文：Jensen Huang in his last hours as Nvidia CEO, per Bloomberg:
> The board met late into the night & left him no choice but to resign
>
> He looked broken, his take-charge style gone
> Started saying things like "whatever" & "I don't care"
> He has since called himself a "piece of sh--"
> He says he no longer cares what happens to him
> His main concern: his wife, and not "ruining the lives" of the women now linked to him

❤ 7,359 · 原帖

NoLimit (@NoLimitGains)

黄仁勋已于周四辞职。
周四晚间，路透社又曝出一段关系，这次涉及另一名英伟达员工。
在不到一周的报道中，已经曝出三段被指控的婚外情。英伟达拒绝置评。

原文：Jensen Huang resigned Thursday.
On Thursday night, Reuters reported yet another relationship, this one with a second Nvidia employee.
That's three alleged affairs in under a week of reporting. Nvidia declined to comment.

❤ 379 · 原帖

Wall St Engine (@wallstengine)

被问及黄仁勋是否应该辞去英伟达 CEO 一职时，特朗普说：
「问题在于，那个女人是间谍吗？我不知道这一点是否已经确定。如果她是间谍，那么是的（应该辞职）。如果她不是间谍，情况也许就不一样了。他是很难被替代的。」

原文：Asked whether Huang should have stepped down as Nvidia CEO, Trump said:
Well, the thing is, was the woman a spy? & I don’t know if that’s been determined yet. But if the woman was a spy, yes. If the woman was not a spy, perhaps it would be different. Its very hard to replace him

❤ 900 · 原帖

Wall St Engine (@wallstengine)

据 Politico 报道，参议院银行委员会主席已传唤黄仁勋和商务部长 Howard Lutnick，就英伟达丑闻出席作证。

原文：The Senate Banking Committee chairman has summoned Jensen Huang and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick to testify over the Nvidia scandal, Politico reports.

❤ 123 · 原帖

独立开发者William (@DLKFZWilliam2)

卧槽，难怪老黄突然辞职了！我刚刚刷到了美国国会这封最后通牒，信息量很大!
1. 首先是这个抬头细节：信里对黄仁勋的称呼已经不再是 CEO，而是直接写成了“英伟达创始人（Founder）”，英伟达火速切割实锤。
而且，是否如果把 CEO 这个切割开，意味着相当于暂时不会对现在英伟达下手，而是对他个人下手。
2. 而且看这三个签名情况，感觉非常不妙。 这是三大实权主席联名，规格罕见：
- 外交委员会主席 Brian Mast（特种兵出身，对华强硬派）
- 对华特别委员会主席 John Moolenaar（芯片封锁头号推手）
- 情报委员会主席 Rick Crawford（掌管最高机密情报）
3. 而且我看这个有点直接先盖棺定论，再问询的感觉，而且这个性质极度严重：
情报委员会亲自下场，说明这直接先定性成 根本不是普通商业质询，而是定性为“涉华间谍渗透与芯片走私”的国家安全调查（直指其婚外情对象涉密及东南亚转运受限 GPU 传闻）。
4. 而且我似乎已经感受到，即使参加了这个，也会有非常严重的后果：
我看到这里面写的国会只给 24 小时考虑（也就是到明晚8点截止），12月1日必须接受闭门笔录问询，否则直接发传票甚至公开听证。
虽然老黄在第一时间辞职了，但是我看到卸任 CEO 也没法豁免作证，然后这个闭门问询 是不能撒谎的，因为一旦撒谎就是联邦重罪.
我估计刚好他们趁这个机会 push 他们的 agenda。无论他去不去，答得怎么样，都可以预料到, 英伟达接下来也必将面临更严厉的出口管制立法锁死。
这其实对全世界的 AI 发展都要敲响一个警钟。

❤ 934 · 原帖

Serenity (@aleabitoreddit)

民意已经表达得很清楚了。
在一项共有 22965 人参与的大规模投票中：
19750 人支持 @JensenHuang 继续担任 $NVDA CEO，反对者仅 1840 人。
在表明立场的受访者中，黄仁勋获得了：
- 91.5% 支持对 8.5% 反对
（10.8 比 1）
这一结果与主流媒体呼吁并庆祝他离职的论调形成鲜明对比。
英伟达董事会应当重新考虑：罢免黄仁勋是否符合股东的最大利益，是否符合美国在 AI 领域领导地位的利益。

原文：The people have spoken.
In the largest large-scale poll of 22,965 respondents:
19,750 supported @JensenHuang remaining CEO of $NVDA, compared with just 1,840 opposing him.
Among respondents expressing a position Jensen received a:
- 91.5% support vs. 8.5% opposition ratio
(10.8 to 1)
The results stands in contrast to prominent media commentary calling for and celebrating his departure.
Nvidia’s board should reconsider whether removing Jensen Huang was in the best interests of its shareholders and American leadership in AI

❤ 1,744 · 原帖

Shay Boloor (@StockSavvyShay)

一些 $NVDA 员工呼吁黄仁勋回归，一篇内部帖子已收到 1600 多条评论，其中包括呼吁给他「第二次机会」的声音。
看来，让员工都成为百万富翁，确实能换来相当多的忠诚。

原文：Some $NVDA employees are calling for Jensen Huang to return with an internal post drawing over 1,600 comments, including calls to give him a “second chance.”
Turns out making your employees millionaires earns you quite a bit of loyalty.

❤ 1,588 · 原帖

Serenity (@aleabitoreddit)

说一下我观点中的细微之处：黄仁勋对 $NVDA 来说是无可替代的。
没有任何其他 CEO 能去韩国的炸鸡店、日本的拉面店走一走，
就能为英伟达的下一个技术愿景调动数千亿美元的资本和供应链承诺。
至于英伟达本身：其路线图完好无损，在黄仁勋领导下形成的现有承诺和收入依然保留。
考虑到他们在 AI 供应链中的根本重要性，5 到 10 年后他们依然会存在。
在新领导人治下，只要 AI 需求不变，他们依然可以继续增长并维持现有业务线。
但我不认识任何人会认为，在其他任何人领导下，不管是蒂姆·库克还是一位会计出身的人：
英伟达还能在产能受限的情况下维持 70% 的同比复合增长，而没有一位像黄仁勋那样做出颠覆性押注的领导者。
至于对 AI 的影响：
我在方向上非常看多，因为 AI 是人类历史上最具变革性的技术。
- 我预计英伟达生态系统可能会出现一些放缓。
我不认为一个会计出身的人能对新云厂商（neocloud）或台湾、韩国、日本的供应链做出同样激进的承诺，超越现有架构，
然后再调动资本和信任去实现它。
- 我确实预计下一任 CEO 会在限制中国获取 GPU 方面与华盛顿的政治立场更加一致
- 我也认为下一任 CEO 对开放权重模型的支持会减少（利好 OpenAI/Anthropic）
- 我对 $NVDA 能否在与 $AMD、$AVGO 以及超大规模云厂商的竞争中保持优势不那么乐观了。
一个人不会打破 AI 交易，我预计从光通信到存储的公司仍会跑赢大盘。
然而，失去黄仁勋之后，我对英伟达在现有路线图之外的下一轮增长的信心已经动摇。

原文：Just to state the nuances of my opinion: Jensen is irreplaceable to $NVDA.
No other CEO can visit a chicken shop in Korea, noodle shop in Japan
And rally hundred of billions of capital and supply chain commitment into Nvidia’s next technological vision.
As for Nvidia: the their roadmap is intact, their existing commitment and revenues are still preserved under Jensen’s leadership.
They’ll still be around 5-10 years from now, given how fundamentally important they are to AI supply chains.
Under a new leader they can still continue growing if AI demand is intact and maintain their current lines.
But I don’t know anyone who can possibly think that under anyone else, whether it’s Tim Cook or an accountant:
That Nvidia could compound 70% capacity constrained growth Y/Y, without a leader like Jensen making these transformational bets.
As for AI implications:
I’m heavily bullish directionally, given AI is the most transformational technology in human history.
- I expect some potential slowdown in Nvidia’s ecosystem.
I don’t think an accountant can make the same aggressive level of commitments to Neoclouds or supply chains in Taiwan, Korea, Japan beyond existing architectures.
Then rally the capital and trust to make it happen.
- I do expect the next CEO to be more politically aligned with Washington in restricting China GPU access
- I also see the next CEO being less supportive of open weight models (positive for OpenAI/Anthropic)
- I’m less optimistic on $NVDA maintaining their competitive advantages against $AMD, $AVGO, and hyperscalers.
One person doesn’t break the AI trade, I expect companies from optics to memory to still outperform.
However, my confidence in the next leg of Nvidia’s growth, beyond their current roadmap, has been shaken without Jensen Huang.

❤ 1,529 · 原帖

Jukan (@jukan05)

即使到现在，英伟达的芯片依然稀缺。
但要把这种溢价最大化，英伟达就必须扶持新云厂商（neocloud）。
如果英伟达新任 CEO 对扶持新云厂商哪怕稍有怀疑，现货价格就会受到冲击。这会损害新云厂商的利润率。为了避免这种情况，新云厂商将别无选择，只能另寻出路：AMD，或者 TPU 阵营。
换句话说，新云厂商将挣脱英伟达的掌控，英伟达的统治力和影响力都会受到打击。这反过来意味着，支撑英伟达唯一护城河——对供应链的控制——的巨额订单量将受到冲击，也意味着英伟达的飞轮会断裂。
黄仁勋不知疲倦地守护着这个飞轮。他多方施压，让各方对新云厂商向中国超大规模云厂商出租算力睁一只眼闭一只眼；他还推动对华芯片出口，好让中国永远忘不了英伟达的味道，不遗余力地让中国的 AI 生态建立在英伟达之上。这样一来，即便最新的 GPU 在中国境内难以获得，人们仍然有理由从海外新云厂商那里租用同样的芯片。把中国开发者留在英伟达生态内，也是保护新云厂商利用率的一种方式。
不过，这一切都是在灰色地带边缘玩火，在华盛顿看来极其不妥且危险。
即便如此，黄仁勋做的是对英伟达最有利的事。这一点无可否认。
黄仁勋本打算等到新云厂商能够自行订购下一代 GPU。在那之前与客户共担风险，他大概认为这也符合英伟达的利益。我现在想知道的是，下一任 CEO 能不能等那么久。
根据《华尔街日报》的文章……现任 CEO 似乎没有那么有耐心。
我为没有黄仁勋的英伟达感到担忧。

原文：Nvidia chips are still scarce, even now.
But to maximize that premium, Nvidia has to support the neoclouds.
If the new Nvidia CEO turns even slightly skeptical about supporting the neoclouds, spot prices will take a hit. That will hurt neocloud margins. To avoid this, the neoclouds will have no choice but to reach out elsewhere. AMD, or the TPU camp.
In other words, the neoclouds break free of Nvidia's grip, and Nvidia's dominance and influence both take a hit. That in turn means a hit to the massive order volume that underpins Nvidia's only moat, its control of the supply chain, and it means Nvidia's flywheel breaks.
Jensen worked tirelessly to protect this flywheel. He pushed on many fronts to get a blind eye turned to neoclouds leasing capacity to Chinese hyperscalers, and he encouraged chip exports to China so that China would never forget the taste of the Nvidia sauce, working relentlessly to have China's AI ecosystem built on top of Nvidia. That way, even if the latest GPUs become hard to get inside China, there is still a reason to rent the same chips from overseas neoclouds. Keeping Chinese developers inside the Nvidia ecosystem was also a way of protecting neocloud utilization.
Still, all of this was playing with fire along the edges of the gray zone, something deeply improper and dangerous in the eyes of Washington.
Even so, Jensen did what was best for Nvidia. That cannot be denied.
Jensen meant to wait until the neoclouds could order the next generation of GPUs on their own. He probably saw sharing risk with customers until then as being in Nvidia's interest too. What I want to know now is whether the next CEO can wait that long.
According to the WSJ article... the current CEO does not seem to be that patient.
I worry about an Nvidia without Jensen.

❤ 1,402 · 原帖

Jukan (@jukan05)

有些人没理解我的意思，那我就直说吧。没有黄仁勋的英伟达，还能再做出像他十年前那样的押注吗？当年他把整个公司都押在了 CUDA 上。
我不认为职业经理人型的 CEO 能做到这一点。这需要一个完全掌控公司、并且有足够个人魅力让整个组织都支持如此高风险押注的人。
这就是我对后黄仁勋时代英伟达的担忧。我怕它会变得更加官僚，成为又一个蒂姆·库克治下的苹果。

原文：Some people are missing my point, so let me put it plainly. Could Nvidia without Jensen ever make another bet like the one he made a decade ago, when he bet the company on CUDA?
I don’t think a professional CEO could pull that off. It takes someone with full control of the company and enough charisma to get the entire organization behind a bet that risky.
That’s what worries me about Nvidia after Jensen. I’m afraid it’ll grow more bureaucratic and become another Apple under Tim Cook.

❤ 952 · 原帖

Jukan (@jukan05)

黄仁勋能像萨姆·奥尔特曼那样东山再起吗？

原文：Could Jensen make a comeback like Sam Altman did?

❤ 1,041 · 原帖

The Kobeissi Letter (@KobeissiLetter)

突发：散户投资者周二买入了 7.3 亿美元的英伟达（$NVDA）股票，创 3 月以来最大单日买入额。
此前周一买入 5.9 亿美元，随后周三又买入 3 亿美元。
截至周三的 3 个交易日里，散户共买入 16 亿美元英伟达股票，是至少 12 个月以来散户最大的 3 日买入额。
同期，2 倍做多英伟达 ETF $NVDL 吸引了 4.01 亿美元资金流入，有望创下 2025 年 11 月以来最大单周流入。
2 倍做多英伟达 ETF $NVDU 吸引了 6400 万美元，有望创下 2026 年 2 月以来最大单周流入。
与此同时，在周四开盘后的前 30 分钟内，散户买入 4.55 亿美元 $NVDA 股票、卖出 3.45 亿美元，净买入 1.11 亿美元，创有记录以来开盘前 30 分钟的最大净买入。
散户正在加码英伟达。

原文：BREAKING: Retail investors bought +$730 million in Nvidia, $NVDA, stock on Tuesday, their largest daily purchase since March.
This was preceded by +$590 million on Monday and followed by +$300 million on Wednesday.
In total, retail investors bought +$1.6 billion in Nvidia shares in 3 trading days ending Wednesday, retail's largest 3-day purchase in at least 12 months.

item.title: X 早报 · 2026-11-12（周四）
item.content:encoded:
X 早报 · 2026-11-12（周四）

概览

英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋在丑闻持续发酵一天后正式辞去 CEO、总裁和董事职务，CFO Colette Kress 出任临时 CEO，Harvey Jones 成为首任董事会主席；英伟达股价一度暴跌逾 10%，累计蒸发约 7500 亿美元市值，多家机构接连下调评级，William Blair 则上调了 AMD。neocloud 板块应声重挫，Nebius（-21%）、CoreWeave（-14%）等大幅下跌，纳指 100 期货跌幅扩大至 1.5%。Nebius 此前发布的财报营收 9.81 亿美元超预期、ARR 达 64 亿美元，并给出 2027 年营收 120 亿至 130 亿美元的指引，但资本支出大幅上调至 400 亿至 450 亿美元。供应链方面，Rubin 量产据传推迟到 2027 年，英伟达削减订单 30% 的传闻被指为 FUD；中国 AI 公司在抢租境外算力，美国商务部据报正敲定限制远程访问的规则。宏观上，10 月核心 CPI 的 3 个月年化涨幅升至 3.75%，小企业涨价意愿创 2008 年以来新高，特朗普威胁对墨西哥关税翻倍。

英伟达：黄仁勋辞任 CEO

The Kobeissi Letter (@KobeissiLetter)

突发：英伟达（$NVDA）CEO 黄仁勋已辞去 CEO、总裁及董事会成员职务，即刻生效。

原文：BREAKING: Nvidia, $NVDA, CEO Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO, President, and member of the Board of Directors, effective immediately.

❤ 9,041 · 原帖

The Kobeissi Letter (@KobeissiLetter)

突发：英伟达（$NVDA）已任命现任 CFO Colette Kress 为临时 CEO。
黄仁勋 33 年的英伟达生涯正式结束。

原文：BREAKING: Nvidia, $NVDA, has appointed Colette Kress, the company’s current CFO, as Interim CEO.
Jensen Huang’s 33-year career at Nvidia has officially come to an end.

❤ 2,299 · 原帖

Wall St Engine (@wallstengine)

黄仁勋辞去 $NVDA CEO 职务，即刻生效。
CFO Colette Kress 出任临时 CEO，同时继续担任 CFO。Harvey Jones 被任命为英伟达首任董事会主席。
英伟达董事会正启动永久 CEO 的遴选，将同时考虑内部和外部人选。

原文：JENSEN HUANG RESIGNS AS $NVDA CEO, EFFECTIVE IMMEDIATELY.
CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO while retaining her CFO role. Harvey Jones appointed Nvidia's first-ever board chair.
Nvidia's board is launching a search for a permanent CEO, considering internal and external candidates.

❤ 347 · 原帖

Wall St Engine (@wallstengine)

英伟达就黄仁勋的离任表示：
“黄仁勋对英伟达的贡献意义深远。英伟达是全球最具影响力的科技公司之一。董事会和公司感谢黄仁勋为公司和行业所做的无可估量的贡献。”

原文：Nvidia on Jensen Huang:
“Jensen’s contributions to NVIDIA are profound. NVIDIA is one of the most consequential technology companies in the world. The Board and the company thank Jensen for his immeasurable contributions to the company and the industry.”

❤ 215 · 原帖

The Kobeissi Letter (@KobeissiLetter)

突发：黄仁勋正式辞去 CEO 后，英伟达股价（$NVDA）暴跌逾 10%。
自丑闻爆发以来，该股已蒸发 7500 亿美元市值。

原文：BREAKING: Nvidia stock, $NVDA, plunges over -10% after Jensen Huang officially resigns as CEO.
The stock has now erased -$750 billion in market cap since the scandal began.

❤ 1,879 · 原帖

Naval (@naval)

你本该从史蒂夫·乔布斯和特拉维斯·卡兰尼克的经历中吸取教训：创始人不是说换就能换的……

原文：You’d think we’d have learned from Steve Jobs and Travis Kalanick that one does not just simply replace the founder…

❤ 19,659 · 原帖

Serenity (@aleabitoreddit)

我不同意，黄仁勋对 $NVDA 来说几乎无可替代。
这就好比把埃隆从 $TSLA 拿走，公司的估值和信心都会崩塌。
他在 AI 兴起之前就押注 CUDA，打造了 Neocloud（新兴云）生态……
提前数年锁定关键供应链产能，并销售机架级系统（含 CPU、网络等）。
把 ASIC 的威胁转化为新的机会，投资 $MRVL、联发科，与 $AVGO 竞争，把它们都纳入英伟达的 NVLink 生态……
这是极其惊人的远见。黄仁勋几乎一手构建了当前 AI 交易背后的金融和产业生态。
黄仁勋把英伟达从一家初创公司带到了市值 5 万亿美元以上的公司，而且他还能在这样的体量上保持增长，预计 FY2028 受限的前瞻增速达 70%……
同样荒谬得令人惊叹。
我通常不发公司的负面内容……但即便未来两年你看不到营收或路线图的实质变化，
赶走 AI 交易的门面和技术远见者，长期来看也可能给英伟达带来灾难。

原文：I disagree, Jensen Huang is practically irreplaceable from $NVDA.
And it's like if you took out Elon from $TSLA, the valuation and confidence in the company would collapse.
The foresight to bet on CUDA before AI took off, build the Neocloud ecosystem...
The move to secure critical supply chain capacity years ahead of demand, and sell rack-scale systems (with CPUs, networking, etc).
Turn the ASIC threat into another opportunity by investing in $MRVL, MediaTek, to compete against $AVGO. Bringing them all into Nvidia's NVLink ecosystem...
Is absolutely insane foresight. Jensen practically architected both the financial and industrial ecosystem surrounding the current AI trade.
Jensen took Nvidia from a startup to a $5T+ company, and the fact he managed to keep growing that with projected FY2028 70% constrained forward growth... at these levels.
Is equally as absurd.
I normally don't post negative things about companies... but even if you don't see material revenue or roadmap changes in the next 2 years.
Ousting the face of the AI trade and a technology visionary might spell disaster for Nvidia long term.

❤ 2,851 · 原帖

Serenity (@aleabitoreddit)

$NVDA 黄仁勋现在已经辞职。
尽管全球范围内和他的员工都给予了压倒性的支持。
这是英伟达一个时代的终结。

原文：$NVDA Jensen Huang has now resigned.
Despite the overwhelming support worldwide and from his employees.
This is an end of an era for Nvidia. https://t.co/GwtmTgkHBa

❤ 1,649 · 原帖

Citrini (@citrini)

向自 ChatGPT 发布以来第一份成功的 NVDA 做空报告致敬。真希望我早点读到它。

原文：Huge hat tip to the first successful NVDA short report since ChatGPT was released. Wish I’d read it earlier.

❤ 1,438 · 原帖

Dan Ives (@DivesTech)

我们预计此时黄仁勋将被免去英伟达 CEO 职务，决定权在董事会手中。我们认为没有黄仁勋的股票估值为 225 美元（黄仁勋担任 CEO 时为 300 美元）。此时，市场已有预期：股价将开始计入没有黄仁勋的英伟达 👇

原文：We expect Jensen to be removed as CEO of Nvidia at this point and it’s in the Board’s hands. We see the stock valuation at $225 without Jensen ($300 with Jensen as CEO). At this point, writing on the wall for Street as stock will now bake in Nvidia without Jensen going forward 👇

❤ 855 · 原帖

The Kobeissi Letter (@KobeissiLetter)

突发：黄仁勋辞去英伟达 CEO 后，美国 neocloud 概念股崩盘：
1. Nebius，$NBIS：-21%
2. CoreWeave，$CRWV：-14%
3. Roundhill Neocloud ETF，$NEO：-13%
4. IREN，$IREN：-9%
5. Cipher Digital，$CIFR：-9%
6. Applied Digital，$APLD：-8%
7. TeraWulf，$WULF：-7%
8. Core Scientific，$CORZ：-5%
纳斯达克 100 指数期货当日跌幅扩大至 -1.5%。

原文：BREAKING: US neocloud stocks collapse after Jensen Huang resigns as CEO of Nvidia:
1. Nebius, $NBIS: -21%
2. CoreWeave, $CRWV: -14%
3. Roundhill Neocloud ETF, $NEO: -13%
4. IREN, $IREN: -9%
5. Cipher Digital, $CIFR: -9%
6. Applied Digital, $APLD: -8%
7. TeraWulf, $WULF: -7%
8. Core Scientific, $CORZ: -5%
Nasdaq 100 futures extend losses to -1.5% on the day.

❤ 408 · 原帖

Leto Bao (@leto_bao)

11 月 9 日，我做多了英伟达。
理由很简单：当时能决定黄仁勋去留的人都在保他。董事会说信任，特朗普说他该留任。
两天后，这两个理由都靠不住了。
今天早上我把整件事从头复盘了一遍，结论是：这不是两周的事，引线埋了四年。
2022 年美国出台首轮对华 AI 芯片禁令，黄仁勋的应对主要是商业上的：推出降规版芯片接着卖，嘴上批评管制，但没有亲自下场游说白宫。
2024 年初他认识了黄乐。2025 年起，他开始高调游说华盛顿，多次面见特朗普，结果是 H20 和 H200 先后放行。中国的大模型也从这时候开始快速缩短与美国模型的距离。美国情报部门的备忘录认为，推动英伟达游说正是黄乐的任务之一。
放行惹怒了两党的对华鹰派。与此同时，情报部门在调查 Megaspeed 时发现了两人的关系。2025 年 10 月和 2026 年 5 月，特朗普两次听取汇报，都没有动作，5 月还带着黄仁勋去了北京。10 月 6 日，英伟达收于 239.24 美元，创历史新高。
内部渠道走不通，就只剩媒体。10 月 29 日《纽约时报》首次曝光，11 月 8 日黄仁勋承认出轨。
11 月 9 日我的判断是：间谍这条线已经摊开，董事会和白宫都公开力挺，最坏的消息出完了，这事算翻篇。
结果今天早上第二轮报道出来：《纽约时报》称他与一名直接下属有染，《华尔街日报》称董事会准备罢免他。两条都是匿名信源，公司还没确认。这是我完全没预想到的黑天鹅。第一段关系是国家安全问题，白宫可以保；第二段是公司治理问题，董事会很难再保。
董事会不算黄仁勋本人有 10 人。按我的推测，保黄派只有 3 位元老，倒黄派有 5 人，另外 2 人摇摆，过半只需要 6 票。倒黄派里有 4 位持股很少，罢免带来的股价下跌对他们几乎没有影响，不罢免反而可能被股东追责。所以我认为罢免大概率会通过。没有黄仁勋的英伟达，估值要大打折扣，分析师估计还要再跌 25% 到 30%。
不管今晚结果如何，我都会在开盘后平掉全部 $NVDA 期权。即使罢免没通过，放料的人手里可能还有东西，短期看不清。
往后看，对华鹰派很可能成为华盛顿的主流。一直对华发疯的 Anthropic 会是 AI 板块里最大的赢家。

❤ 535 · 原帖

qinbafrank (@qinbafrank)

英伟达的董事会能保住老黄么？再聊聊老黄的这次桃色事件。1、看下图英伟达董事会里包括老黄在内11名董事，有6位任职超过十三年，即使2019年加入英伟达董事会的Stephen也是1993年起就给英伟达提供法律服务。这意味着有7位董事很老黄共事很久，经历过英伟达过去的高峰低谷、能深刻认识老黄对于英伟达的不可或缺，他的远见、决断力以及魄力是英伟达走到现在的关键因素。
从董事会的构成看、老黄的亲密战友还是占多数的。
2、最终取决于在于调查的结果，
独立董事正式聘请 Wachtell 律所及纽约南区前代理联邦检察官 Joon Kim 主持调查，董事会把事实调查交给了外部律师。
1）这个调查是昨天的消息调查重点还是跟黄乐的关系，以及有没有泄漏相关机密；
2）今天纽约时报报道的跟女下属的婚外情、估计也是新的调查方向。
这个跟女下属的婚外情现在所有的报道就是曾在英伟达工作的匿名消息源头说两人有关系，但是都还没有明确的证实，最早纽约时报的报道记者说也没看到相关视频。
但这点恰恰最最关键，决定了是事实确凿还是扑风捉影。
3、能看出来这次倒黄动作势大力猛
先是黄乐，再是powell，特别是powe
ll这个现在所有的媒体报道都没有明确的实质性证据，都是匿名消息源的说法，这一点非常值得怀疑。然后纽约时报又传统的左派媒体，跟民主党关系亲密不能不让人生疑。
当然也看到有说法anthropic的联创JackClark也给媒体提供了信息，他之前本身就是科技记者。老黄力推开源，DarioAmodei主张闭源、激烈路线之争。
倒黄派可能是看到了单凭黄乐还不足以让老黄离开、所以又拿跟女下属powell的关系做文章。
当然这些都是我们吃瓜群众的揣测。
从董事会构成上来看，想保住老黄的应该还是占大多数，但最后还是回到调查结果：
1）如果跟女下属powell婚外情被证实，再叠加跟黄乐的关系。老黄大概率是要离任的，即使不完全离开公司但是ceo估计是很难继续了、也可能有一个比较长的过渡期或者担任顾问。
但这对英伟达来说中长期影响还是不小，毕竟像开头说再有一个能有老黄那样的远见、决断力和魄力的ceo概率很小。
这种情况下，最终结果出来短线可以博一个大反弹，因为核心竞争力也没那么快就没了。长期就要边走边看、看实际经营状况了，看接任者能不能真的撑得住。
2）如果跟powell关系被证实子虚乌有、光黄乐感觉撼动老黄的概率不大。大概率黄乐就是一个倒卖芯片的掮客，是间谍的可能性很小老黄泄露机密概率也不大，这种情况下董事会应该还是会保住老黄的。
甚至英伟达的前几大股东贝莱德、先锋、富达、道富等机构都不想老黄走人，毕竟在老黄身上利益巨大。
这种情况英伟达被砸下来就是一个真正的黄金坑了
本条由@bitget_zh赞助，「Bitget 买美股：秒级入场，丝滑交易

Shay Boloor (@StockSavvyShay)

Jukan (@jukan05)

传闻更具体一些。午饭后，台湾开始流传英伟达将订单量削减 30% 的消息，AI 相关股票全线下跌，从 CCL、PCB 厂商到晶圆代工厂无一幸免。我认为 30% 这个数字毫无道理，在我看来是 FUD（恐慌、不确定与怀疑），不过我会继续深挖。

原文：The rumor is a bit more specific. After lunch, word started circulating in Taiwan that NVIDIA had cut its order volume by 30%, and AI-related stocks sold off across the board, from CCL and PCB makers to foundries. I think the 30% figure makes no sense. This looks like FUD to me, but I’ll dig into it.

在发布关于订单削减传闻的帖子后，我与多家基金和供应链人士聊过。目前流传的一个说法是 CCL 订单被削减了 30%。我交流的一位消息人士说这一说法不实。
希望对大家有帮助。谢谢。

原文：Re: the rumor that NVIDIA cut orders
One thing I’ve been able to confirm is that Rubin has been delayed again. I’m told motherboard warpage caused the latest delay and that the HBM issue was resolved in October. (As it happens, Korean media reported today that SK hynix’s HBM4 yield had reached 70%.) As a result, volume shipments of Rubin have slipped to 2027, and I’m told NVIDIA has increased its Blackwell orders in the meantime.
Since posting about the rumored order cuts, I’ve spoken with several funds and supply chain contacts. One rumor making the rounds is that CCL orders were cut by 30%. One source I spoke with said that claim was false.
I hope this helps. Thanks.

原文：More details from Nebius $NBIS Q3 report:
2026 capex rises to ~$27B, above the prior $20B-$25B range. Expects FY27 capex of $40B-$45B, up from its $27B FY26 guide.
ARR reached $6.4B at the end of Sep, up 113% from $3B in June. Nebius had guided to $7B-$9B by December and now expects ARR above $7B in February, about two months later.
First 2027 outlook: revenue of $12B-$13B vs 12B Est, about four times 2026, with pre-tax breakeven in Q4 2027. Capex of $40B-$45B for more than 1 GW of new capacity, 75%-85% covered by prepayments and asset-backed financing.
Customers have committed over $12B in contract value since the start of Q3. Prepayments on Q3 deals covered more than 100% of the related capex, up from 50%-60% in Q2.
Payback on comparable 1-3 year deals improved to 1 year 7 months, from 1 year 10 months.
Nebius AI cloud revenue was $973.8M, up 643% YoY and about 99% of group revenue.
Contracted power is above 4 GW today, with 5 GW still expected by year-end.
Adjusted net income was $90.9M, from an adjusted net loss of $100.4M a year earlier.
Servers and network equipment are now depreciated over five years, up from four before 2026.
From 2027, Nebius will guide on revenue, pre-tax earnings and capacity instead of ARR.

截至 9 月底，ARR 已达 64 亿美元。管理层评论方面：

- 平均 GPU 价格环比上涨 20% 以上，回收期从 22 个月缩短至 19 个月

关于子公司：

4. Tavily——开发者超过 300 万，$IBM 作为核心合作伙伴进行后训练。
5. ClickHouse——没有提及新的二级市场估值，但可以看到估值在上升
6. TokenFactory——合同价值环比增长 17 倍
我看到的主要负面因素是：由于 $MSFT 的产能交付推迟到 2027 年第二季度，2026 年指引现在处于较低端（接近约 30 亿美元）。
显然第三方合作伙伴 DataOne 出现了执行失误。在 $BE 燃料电池产能上线足够之前，临时发电机因许可问题被撤下。
2026 年资本支出也从 200 亿至 250 亿美元提高到 270 亿美元，同时下调了营收预期。
所以近期的不利因素有点让人想起 AOI 的财报；不过从长期来看，我认为 Nebius 会让你满意。
2027 年展望：
- 营收 120 亿至 130 亿美元，资本支出 400 亿至 450 亿美元，2027 年底实现税前盈亏平衡。
运营上非常乐观：预付款覆盖资本支出，GPU 溢价上升。主要的下行因素是第三方造成的近期执行风险，导致近期延迟和收入确认推迟。
总体而言，Nebius 这个季度非常出色。

原文：Regarding $NBIS earnings results:
To show you how fast they're growing... from Q2 to Q3:
Revenue: $582.3M -> $980.8M (+68% QoQ)
Adjusted EBITDA: $236.2M -> $465.8M (+97% QoQ)
AI cloud adj. EBITDA margin: 49.7% -> 53.2%
Net Income: −$190.4M -> −$37.5M
ARR has reached $6.4B at the end of Sep. In terms of management commentary:
- Since start of Q3, Nebius signed $12B+ of new contracts
- Average GPU pricing rose 20%+ sequentially, payback shortened from 22M -> 19M
- On Q3 deals, prepayments covered 100% of associated capex, up from 50–60% in Q2 (insane for financing)
- Contract value per MW exceeded $25M+ from Q3 up from ~$20M Q2
- 5GW contracted power year end
With $10B of committed customer prepayments in 2026 and $17B-$20B in 2027. Now, prepayments and borrowing against existing contracts covers ~75-85% of 2027 capex.
On subsidiaries:
1. Avride - 250 autonomous vehicles fleet, over 100,000 passenger rides (with companies like $UBER). Fully driverless robotaxi targeted H1 2027.
2. Toloka - Revenue doubled sequentially
3. Enterprise cloud - Databricks and Datadog selected Neibus. Along with a new agreement with Snowflake.
4. Tavily - Over 3M developers now with $IBM post-training a core partner.
5. ClickHouse - Nothing about new secondary valuations, but we can see valuations growing
6. TokenFactory - Contract value grew 17x sequentially
The primary negative I saw was that 2026 guidance is now on the lower end (near ~$3B), due to $MSFT capacity deliveries slipping to Q2 2027.
Apparently there was an execution miss with a third party partner DataOne. Temporary generators were retired amid permitting issues before enough $BE fuel cell capacity came online.
Capex also increased in 2026 from $20B-$25B to $27B, while revising revenue expectations downward.
So near-term unfortunate headwinds kinda reminiscent of AOI earnings; however long term I think Nebius will take care of you.
For 2027 outlook:
- $12-13 billion revenue, capex of $40-45 billion, pre-tax breakeven by the end of 2027.
Very operationally bullish, as seen with prepayments covering capex, GPU premiums increasing. Main downside is near-term execution risk from third parties, causing near-term delays and revenue recognition.
Great quarter from Nebius overall.

不到 24 小时后，英伟达的公关负责人就直接联系了我们，回应我们的分析。他们发给我们的信息附在下方。
当时，在此前的 3 个季度中，英伟达来自新加坡的营收为 174 亿美元，而来自中国的为 116 亿美元。

英伟达公关团队给我们发来的信息如下：
“与新加坡相关的营收并不表明产品被转运至中国。我们的公开文件报告的是客户的‘账单地址’而非‘发货地址’。我们的许多客户在新加坡设有业务实体，并通过这些实体采购发往美国和西方的产品。我们要求合作伙伴遵守所有适用法律，一旦收到相反信息，会采取相应行动。我们上一份 10-Q 指出：‘与新加坡营收相关的大部分货物都运往了新加坡以外的地点，运往新加坡的货物微不足道。’”

原文：Our direct experience with Nvidia, never shared before:
22 months ago, we published the below analysis raising concerns that Nvidia's AI chips were potentially being routed to China through Singapore.
Less than 24 hours later, Nvidia's Head of PR contacted us, directly addressing our analysis. Their message to us is included below.
At the time, in the previous 3 quarters, $17.4 billion of Nvidia's revenue came from Singapore versus $11.6 billion from China.
Furthermore, at the time, the US had ~5,375 data centers, China had 448, and Singapore had just 99. The numbers just did not add up. You can read our full analysis below.
Nvidia's PR team sent us the following message:
"The revenue associated with Singapore does not indicate diversion to China. Our public filings report 'bill to' not 'ship to' locations of our customers. Many of our customers have business entities in Singapore and use those entities for products destined for the US and the West. We insist that our partners comply with all applicable laws, and if we receive any information to the contrary, act accordingly. Our last 10-Q noted: 'most shipments associated with Singapore revenue were to locations other than Singapore and shipments to Singapore were insignificant.'"
Fast forward to today.
According to new reports, Nvidia, $NVDA, CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with a suspected Chinese spy helped facilitate at least $7.5 billion in Nvidia chip shipments to Chinese companies through a network spanning China and Singapore.
The reported shipments date back to 2023 and involved ~240,000 advanced Nvidia AI chips.
These allegations remain under investigation, and it is not yet established whether the shipments were connected to the revenue discrepancies we highlighted 22 months ago.
Nvidia maintains that it has no reason to believe US national security or company secrets were compromised.
But the overlap between these new allegations and the questions we raised in January 2025, along with Nvidia's response to us at the time, is noteworthy.
We stand by our view that Jensen Huang is likely to remain CEO of Nvidia and will continue to be an integral figure in the AI Revolution.
We expect more on this soon.

原文：Coreweave $CRWV +13%:
Beat across the board: revenue +168%, backlog +138%. Raised its 2026 guide, nudged capex up.
Financing visibility looks much better:
No new unsecured debt planned through '27 at current yields & less than $5B of new parent-level capital expected.
Its next loan is expected to be investment-grade, yield 7%-7.5%, and fund over 90% of the capex it's tied to. Over 75% of committed capex through 2027 is tied to investment-grade and enterprise customers.
About $9B in customer prepayments and deposits is expected over the next 3 months from signed contracts. Over $3B is for already-paid-off GPUs, requiring no new capex or debt service.
DEMAND ISN'T THE ISSUE.
It's "largely sold out through 2027," and all 2028 capacity offered so far has sold. Qualified demand is 10x available capacity through 2027, while 2028 demand is already several times supply.
The older GPU fleet is getting more valuable, not less.
Ampere and Hopper pricing jumped 30%-50% QoQ, above their original contract rates. Over 130K GPUs roll off contract in 2027 and ~170K in 2028. Re-renting them at today's prices could generate nearly $10B in additional annualized revenue with no new capex, none of it in the backlog yet.
New 4-5 year deals now price at $20M-$25M per megawatt a year. Short-term capacity goes for over $40M and can pay back its capex in 6-18 months.
Margins are improving: adjusted operating margin went 1% → 5% → 10% across Q1-Q3. Management expects positive adjusted net income in 1H 2028.
Capex can flatten. If it only builds the committed backlog, 2027 capex stays around 2026's $37B-$39B while revenue and EBITDA grow.
WHAT'S STILL OPEN:
Q3 capex was $14.5B on $3.7B of revenue, and interest expense of $846M was over 4x GAAP operating income of $207M, with Q4 interest guided above $1B.
The parent raise could tap its new ATM for up to 35M shares, but management didn't specify. And there's no quantified downside case if GPU supply catches up and shortage pricing fades.

意味着27年上半年内长债的发行规模要么维持不变、要么还可能略微减少；
对长债而言，拍卖规模稳定叠加回购，暂时减轻久期供给压力，期限溢价或受支撑，当然长端中长期还是取决于增长与通胀预期。
2、TGA路径
季度再融资声明给出了TGA两个月内峰值与一个季末锚：11月下旬和2027年1月下旬TGA或达1.025万亿（±500亿），12月底则维持8500亿目标不变；
以11月4日准备金2.963万亿、TGA 0.936万亿为基准（合计约3.899万亿），在隔夜逆回购已经见底的情况，TGA的增减直接会导致银行准备金的减增。
正好测算下路径：
1）11月下旬TGA现金峰值对应准备金约2.87万亿；
2）12月底TGA降至8500亿，准备金回升至约3.05万亿（基本上也就是9月下旬的高点水平）；
3）1月下旬再次冲高至1.025万亿，准备金回落至约2.87万亿。
11月9日TGA已降至9226亿，下旬前仍有约1000亿现金重建压力，对应准备金回笼；
12月若从高点释放1750亿，改善空间明确，1月则因季节性支出前补现金，年底释放部分将被收回。
结算节奏上，
11月16日、30日及12月中下旬附息债与税款入账可能带来阶段性波动。一季度净借款升至8000亿，主要因现金管理方向反转（四季度动用存量、一季度需补充），而非单纯赤字扩大。

半导体的泡沫我认为已经被挤掉了很多，提前定价了周期下行利润率下降，财报如果证明周期比预期长，现在就过于悲观。虽然我不期待短时间回新高，也不可能，趋势起来需要很多事件情绪面的叠加，现在看不到。但对比很多价值股板块的估值，长期来看半导体，科技股的性价比明显更高。这一波市场的降温也不见得是坏事，让所有企业在投资时变得更谨慎，债券市场现在借钱也非常难，让借钱的也变得更谨慎。

This also marks their 5th-largest quarterly purchase on record.
Central bank gold purchases were up +8% from +296 tonnes acquired in Q2 2026 and up +453% from Q1 2026.
By comparison, the 5-year quarterly average stands at +227 tonnes.
China and Poland led Q3 demand, adding +63 tonnes and +40 tonnes, respectively.

与此同时，受全球对 AI 相关电子产品需求激增推动，货物出口同比增长 30.4%，高于第二季度的 28.9% 和第一季度的 23.8%。

This follows +4.2% YoY growth in Q2 and marks its 15th consecutive quarterly economic expansion.
This comes as goods exports surged +30.4% YoY, up from +28.9% in Q2 and +23.8% in Q1, driven by surging global demand for AI-related electronics.
At the same time, inbound tourism and domestic infrastructure investment further boosted economic activity.

Hong Kong is seeing transformative growth amid the global AI investment cycle.

其他

Wall St Engine (@wallstengine)

任天堂重制了一款 1998 年的塞尔达游戏
仅 4 天就卖出 520 万份
这款游戏是《塞尔达传说：时之笛》，最初于 1998 年在 Nintendo 64 上发售。
任天堂为 Switch 2 从头重制了它，采用全新的画面、关卡和角色设计。游戏于 11 月 5 日发售，售价 59.99 美元。
原版在 N64 上的生命周期销量约 760 万份。重制版仅用四天就达到了这一总量的 68%。
它已超过《大金刚 蕉力全开》的总销量。在该平台上，只有与 Switch 2 主机捆绑销售的《马力欧赛车 世界》卖得更多。
评论家和玩家在 Metacritic 上都给出了 96 分。1998 年的原版至今仍保持着 Metacritic 史上最高分：99 分。
这个时机对任天堂很重要。
7 月至 9 月，Switch 2 硬件销量同比下降 41%，而存储芯片成本上涨也推高了主机价格。
2017 年，《旷野之息》曾帮助带动初代 Switch 的销量。这款重制版可能在假日季为 Switch 2 发挥类似作用。
任天堂最新的爆款，已经 28 岁了。

原文：NINTENDO REMADE A 1998 ZELDA GAME
IT SOLD 5.2 MILLION COPIES IN JUST 4 DAYS
The game is The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, originally released on the Nintendo 64 in 1998.
Nintendo rebuilt it from the ground up for Switch 2, with new graphics, levels and character designs. It launched on Nov. 5 for $59.99.
The original sold about 7.6 million copies over its lifetime on the N64. The remake reached 68% of that total in just four days.
It has already surpassed Donkey Kong Bananza's lifetime sales. ONLY MARIO KART WORLD, which was bundled with the Switch 2 console, has sold more on the platform.
Critics and players have both given it a 96 on Metacritic. The 1998 original still holds Metacritic's highest score ever: 99.
The timing is important for Nintendo.
Switch 2 hardware sales fell 41% YoY from July through September, while rising memory chip costs have also pushed console prices higher.
Back in 2017, Breath of the Wild helped drive sales of the original Switch. This remake could play a similar role for Switch 2 heading into the holiday season.
Nintendo's newest hit is 28 years old.

item.title: X 早报 · 2026-11-10（周二）
item.content:encoded:
X 早报 · 2026-11-10（周二）

概览

黄仁勋丑闻继续发酵：据 The Information 报道，他与涉嫌中国间谍者的关系促成了至少 75 亿美元的芯片出货，《纽约时报》称特朗普早在 2025 年 10 月就被告知此事；特朗普则表示相信黄仁勋不知情。风波让限制对华芯片的三项法案更易推进，白宫也转而支持封堵芯片远程访问。英伟达自 10 月高点已回撤约 25%，市值跌至 4.3 万亿美元，苹果重夺全球第一。10 月 CPI 环比上涨 0.4%、核心 CPI 上涨 0.3%，均高于预期，且因 2025 年政府停摆没有同比数据。数据公布后纳指期货跌约 1.5%，2 年期美债收益率大涨 16.5 个基点，市场对 12 月加息的定价升至 80% 以上，沃勒甚至表示可考虑加息 50 个基点。另一方面，特朗普暗示无需再打击伊朗，美油跌破 85 美元；9 月消费信贷创纪录增长 290 亿美元。Anthropic IPO 条款出炉：发行 8.25 亿股、每股 70–78 美元，募资最多 644 亿美元，估值约 1.02 万亿美元，仅略高于私募估值；谷歌、英伟达等 7 家巨头将通过私募配售认购 260 亿美元。S-1 显示其年化营收已达 810 亿美元，但高价短期算力让第三季度由盈转亏。产业链方面，台积电 10 月营收同比增近 60%，董事会再批约 410 亿美元资本开支；软银季度巨亏 70.6 亿美元，主要来自美国 AI 电力设备采购调整，并否认马斯克所说的燃气轮机订单违约；亚马逊发布 250 美元的家用 Ring 安防无人机。

黄仁勋丑闻持续发酵：芯片出货、国会立法与英伟达股价

The Kobeissi Letter (@KobeissiLetter)

突发：据 The Information 报道，英伟达（$NVDA）CEO 黄仁勋与一名涉嫌中国间谍者的关系，促成了至少 75 亿美元的英伟达芯片出货。
据报道，这段关系可追溯到 2023 年。

原文：BREAKING: Nvidia, $NVDA, CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with an alleged Chinese spy facilitated at least $7.5 billion in Nvidia chip shipments, per The Information.
The relationship reportedly dates back to 2023.

❤ 5,696 · 原帖

Dan Ives (@DivesTech)

我们认为，如果黄仁勋被撤换 CEO 职务，英伟达作为公司和股票的价值会大幅缩水（25%–30%），公司的未来方向也会改变，全球 AI GPU 的竞争格局将截然不同，尤其是在中国。在我们看来，目前他被撤换的概率约为 15%。

原文：We believe if Jensen was removed as CEO, Nvidia is worth a lot less (25%-30%) as a company/stock and would change the future direction of the company and create a dramatically different competitive environment around AI GPUs globally especially for China. ~15% chance he removed (as of now) in our view

❤ 1,412 · 原帖

Charlie Bilello (@charliebilello)

“特朗普先生在 2025 年 10 月就被告知，黄女士与黄先生存在关系且被认定为间谍，但总统选择不对这一情报采取任何行动。”——《纽约时报》
嗯，我很好奇这是为什么……

原文："Mr. Trump was briefed in October 2025 that Ms. Huang had a relationship with Mr. Huang and was presumed to be a spy, but the president chose not to do anything with that intelligence." - NY Times
Hmm, I wonder why...

❤ 1,551 · 原帖

Nancy Pelosi Stock Tracker ♟ (@pelositracker)

特朗普总统对英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋婚外情一事的回应
特朗普：“他告诉我，他完全不知道那个女人是间谍，我真的相信他。”

原文：President Trump’s response to CEO of Nvidia, Jensen Huang, affair
Trump: “He told me he had no idea that woman was a spy, and I really believe him”

❤ 577 · 原帖

Jukan (@jukan05)

据 The Information 报道，英伟达长期以来一直极力游说，反对限制中国公司通过海外云服务商获取其最新芯片的提案。但自黄仁勋丑闻曝光以来，这种游说在华盛顿的分量似乎下降了。
据报道，这场风波让三项法案更容易推进：《MATCH 法案》将限制向中国出口光刻设备；《Overwatch 法案》将让国会对商务部批准向中国等国家出售 AI 芯片的决定拥有更大的监督权；《芯片安全法案》将要求 AI 芯片内置追踪功能。
《国防授权法案》预计会在 1 月新一届民主党主导的国会开会之前通过。这让共和党领导层有动力现在就推动这些立法，因为此刻他们对最终法案内容还有更大的话语权。

原文：According to The Information, NVIDIA has long lobbied hard against proposals to restrict Chinese companies’ access to its latest chips through overseas cloud providers. But since the scandal surrounding Jensen Huang broke, that lobbying appears to carry less weight in Washington.
The fallout has reportedly made it easier to advance three bills. The MATCH Act would restrict shipments of lithography equipment to China. The Overwatch Act would give Congress greater oversight of the Commerce Department’s decisions to approve AI chip sales to countries such as China. The Chip Security Act would require AI chips to have built-in tracking capabilities.
The National Defense Authorization Act is expected to pass before the new Democratic-led Congress convenes in January. That gives Republican leaders an incentive to help move the legislation forward now, while they still have more say over what goes into the final bill.

❤ 381 · 原帖

Jukan (@jukan05)

更令人意外的是，据报道白宫本身要求国会在法案中加入一项条款，要求商务部出台规则，阻止对某些芯片的远程访问。这是白宫立场的转变。
如果这项条款通过，GPU 现货价格也可能受到冲击。

原文：What’s even more surprising is that the White House itself reportedly asked Congress to include a provision in the bill requiring the Commerce Department to issue rules blocking remote access to certain chips. That’s a shift in the White House’s position.
If that provision passes, GPU spot prices could take a hit, too.

❤ 269 · 原帖

Shay Boloor (@StockSavvyShay)

“木头姐”凯西·伍德今天买入了约 1600 万美元的 $NVDA。

原文：Cathie Wood bought ~$16M of $NVDA today.

❤ 1,927 · 原帖

Charlie Bilello (@charliebilello)

2026 年 10 月 6 日：英伟达年初至今上涨 28%，市值 5.8 万亿美元，全球第一。
今天：经历 25% 的回撤后，英伟达年初至今下跌 4%，市值 4.3 万亿美元。苹果重新夺回全球市值第一。
仅一个多月就蒸发了 1.5 万亿美元。
$NVDA

原文：Oct 6, 2026: Nvidia was up 28% YTD with a $5.8 trillion market cap, the world's largest.
Today: After a 25% drawdown, Nvidia is now down 4% YTD with a market cap of $4.3 trillion. Apple has reclaimed the world's top spot.
$1.5 trillion erased in just over a month.
$NVDA

❤ 301 · 原帖

Jukan (@jukan05)

台湾媒体报道称，英伟达可能削减对台积电的订单。如果属实，AMD 和 ASIC 芯片厂商可能会接手目前分配给英伟达的部分晶圆产能。
我也听到了类似的传闻，一旦能确认会第一时间告诉大家。

原文：A Taiwanese media report says NVIDIA may cut its orders with TSMC. If that happens, AMD and ASIC chipmakers could pick up some of the wafer capacity currently allocated to NVIDIA.
I’ve heard similar rumors. I’ll let you know as soon as I can confirm them.

❤ 678 · 原帖

NoLimit (@NoLimitGains)

英伟达（$NVDA）最大的问题可能不是 AMD……
而可能是它自己的客户。谷歌（$GOOGL）刚刚又发布了两款自研 AI 芯片，据报道苹果、Meta 和甲骨文都在排队采购。
谷歌每卖出一颗芯片，就有人少买一块英伟达 GPU。

原文：Nvidia's $NVDA biggest problem might not be AMD…
It might be its own customers. Google $GOOGL just announced two more in-house AI chips, and Apple, Meta and Oracle are reportedly lining up for them.
Every chip Google sells is one fewer Nvidia GPU someone buys.

❤ 449 · 原帖

10 月 CPI 超预期，12 月加息几成定局

The Kobeissi Letter (@KobeissiLetter)

突发：10 月 CPI 环比上涨 0.4%，高于预期的 0.3%。
核心 CPI 上涨 0.3%，同样高于预期的 0.2%。
由于 2025 年 10 月政府停摆，美国劳工统计局不会发布同比数据。
通胀看起来仍然偏热。

原文：BREAKING: October CPI inflation rises +0.4% month-over-month, above expectations of +0.3%.
Core CPI inflation rose +0.3%, also above expectations of +0.2%.
BLS will not be releasing year-over-year figures due to the October 2025 government shutdown.
Inflation still appears to be running hot.

❤ 1,968 · 原帖

The Kobeissi Letter (@KobeissiLetter)

突发：美国 CPI 通胀高于预期后，纳斯达克 100 期货下跌 1.5%。
12 月加息的概率正在飙升。

原文：BREAKING: Nasdaq 100 futures fall -1.5% after US CPI inflation comes in higher than expected.
Odds of a December rate hike are surging.

❤ 2,179 · 原帖

The Kobeissi Letter (@KobeissiLetter)

突发：美国劳工统计局（BLS）宣布，本周公布的 10 月 CPI 通胀数据将不包含同比数据。
BLS 表示，2025 年 10 月政府停摆导致的数据缺失“使得可靠的年度比较无法进行”。
我们只会拿到环比数据。

原文：BREAKING: The US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) announces that this week's October CPI inflation data will not include year-over-year numbers.
BLS says that missing data from the October 2025 government shutdown "prevents reliable annual comparisons."
We will only be receiving monthly figures.

❤ 2,337 · 原帖

Wall St Engine (@wallstengine)

🇺🇸 10 月 CPI：
变便宜的：
• 咖啡：-3.6%，有记录以来最大月度跌幅
• 蒸馏烈酒（不含威士忌）：-1.5%，创纪录跌幅
• 二手车：-1.2%，1 月以来最大跌幅
变贵的：
• 生菜：+7.9%
• 城市公交和火车票价：+6.6%

• 外出就餐：+0.5%，去年 12 月以来最大涨幅
以上均为环比变化

原文：OCTOBER'S 🇺🇸 CPI:
What got cheaper:
• Coffee: -3.6%, largest monthly drop on record
• Distilled spirits (ex whiskey): -1.5%, record decline

Wall St Engine (@wallstengine)

Wall St Engine (@wallstengine)

美联储沃勒为 2022 年以来最大幅度加息打开大门
美联储理事克里斯托弗·沃勒表示，即使 10 月 CPI 有所改善，他也会支持在 12 月 8–9 日会议上加息 25 个基点；如果核心 CPI 达到 0.3% 左右或更高，则应考虑加息 50 个基点。

原文：FED'S WALLER OPENS DOOR TO LARGEST RATE HIKE SINCE 2022
Fed Governor Christopher Waller says he would back a quarter-point hike at the Dec 8–9 meeting even if October CPI improves, and a half-point hike should be considered if core CPI comes in around 0.3% or higher.

❤ 89 · 原帖

qinbafrank (@qinbafrank)

今晚我们将看到只有环比没有同比的10月CPI数据，为何这次不会公布同比数据？去年10月美国政府停摆，导致当时那个月通胀数据缺失、所以算今年10月同比的基数就没有了，同时实际收入同比增速数据也不会公布。如果只看环比数据，个人预期10月cpi环比是要走弱的。原因是：

原文：What Anthropic's S-1 discloses about its expensive short term chip rentals (aimed at SpaceX)
- Most compute is secured 12 to 18 months in advance under multiyear contracts. When customer or research demand exceeds that capacity, the company buys short term compute, which "currently" costs "significantly more" than comparable compute under multiyear contracts.
- The scale was $5.0 billion in Q3 and $6.5 billion over the first nine months.
- Operating income of $970 million in Q2 turned into an operating loss of $570 million in Q3. The company attributes this to $5.0 billion of short term compute and $2.0 billion of noncash donation matching charges.
- Use of short term compute will keep increasing in the near term, and operating margin will be compressed as a result.
- As of the end of September, minimum payments under short term contracts (cancelable without penalty within one year, or with a remaining term of one year or less) were about $17.4 billion. About $6.6 billion more has been signed since October.
- Once Anthropic Direct, under which the company leases chips directly and hosts them in dedicated data centers, comes online, the company will replace the short term compute bought during demand surges with cheaper long term compute.
Interpretation:
- Excluding short term capacity, Q3 compute cost was $4.86 billion, below the Q2 total of $5.56 billion. Long term contracted capacity barely grew in Q3. In effect, the $5.4 billion increase in revenue was served with short term capacity.
- Revenue per dollar of compute fell from $2.08 in Q2 to $1.72 in Q3. The company also notes that this metric declined from the prior quarter.
- The $17.4 billion short term contract balance plus the $6.6 billion of new contracts comes to $24.0 billion, about one third of the $70.7 billion due over the next 12 months. More than the Q3 pace ($5.0 billion a quarter) is already under contract.
Question: Will Anthropic keep paying SpaceX a huge premium after March 2027?
Source: Anthropic’s S-1 filing

item.title: X 早报 · 2026-11-09（周一）
item.content:encoded:
X 早报 · 2026-11-09（周一）

概览

今天的主线是黄仁勋丑闻：他在致员工信中承认婚外情，对象据报道涉嫌中国间谍，英伟达董事会启动独立调查并称暂无国安或机密泄露迹象；中方否认，特朗普力挺并称可能带他出访亚洲。分析人士认为真正风险在国会对 GPU 对华销售的追查（11 月 18 日有闭门听证），也有人担心他被迫下台。市场反应剧烈但短暂：周日晚期货开盘 7 分钟内标普隐含市值先蒸发 3000 亿美元又回补 3500 亿；英伟达盘前跌超 5–6% 并跌破 180 美元，但台股加权指数大涨 4.94%（史上第二大单日涨幅），台湾同时大幅收紧融券。周一早盘期货转涨，油价跌破 90 美元。宏观方面，M2 同比增 5.7% 创 2022 年来最快，数据中心建设支出同比激增 90% 至纪录高位，失业率连续 62 个月低于 5%，制造业连续 5 个月增员；但卡车运输业破产数有望创 23 年新高，全球约 45% 央行近 3 个月加息。伊朗据报放弃控制霍尔木兹海峡的要求，卡塔尔将提出复航方案。产业层面，多家芯片与数据中心公司高管称需求远超供给、抛售与基本面脱节；谷歌推出两款第八代 TPU 新配置且产能已售罄，Oppenheimer 上调 AMD 评级，马斯克 Terafab 据报目标 2032 年后月产 100 万片晶圆（七成存储）。美光 12 月 9 日起可回购，Constellation 财报超预期并签下谷歌、亚马逊长期购电协议。

黄仁勋丑闻：婚外情、间谍疑云与董事会调查

Mark Gurman (@markgurman)

突发新闻，来自 @ianmking：英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋承认婚外情，公司董事会正在调查他是否成为一起中国间谍阴谋的目标。他目前仍担任 CEO。

原文：Breaking news from @ianmking: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admits to extramarital affair and the company board is now investigating him being targeted by a Chinese espionage plot. He remains CEO for now.

❤ 9,563 · 原帖

Wall St Engine (@wallstengine)

Axios 获得的英伟达（$NVDA）CEO 黄仁勋致员工备忘录草稿：
“我欠我的家人和你们所有人一个道歉。”
“我对妻子不忠。我的行为伤害了她和我们的孩子。我所做的事没有任何借口。我深感抱歉。”
“领导英伟达是我一生的荣幸。”
“我会全身心投入英伟达，并努力重新赢得你们的信任。”
关于国家安全调查：
“我支持这项调查，并将全力配合。”
“我的家人不必为我的选择负责，责任在我。请给他们隐私。”
英伟达董事会已就有关黄仁勋成为外国情报行动目标的报道启动独立调查。
董事会表示，目前没有理由认为美国国家安全或英伟达的机密遭到泄露。

原文：$NVDA CEO JENSEN HUANG’S DRAFT MEMO TO EMPLOYEES, OBTAINED BY AXIOS.
“I owe my family and all of you an apology.”
“I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry.”
“Leading NVIDIA is the privilege of my life.”
“I am fully committed to NVIDIA and will work to earn back your confidence.”
Regarding the national security investigation:
“I support the investigation and will cooperate fully.”
“My family bears no responsibility for my choices. I do. Please give them privacy.”
NVIDIA’s board has launched an independent investigation into reports that Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort.
The board says it currently has no reason to believe U.S. national security or NVIDIA’s secrets were compromised.

英伟达（$NVDA）刚刚宣布，董事会将就 CEO 黄仁勋成为外国情报行动目标的报道展开独立调查。
董事会强调，它“没有理由认为国家安全或英伟达的机密遭到泄露”，同时重申在黄仁勋配合调查期间对他的信任。

原文：$NVDA just announced an independent board investigation into reports that CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort.
The board emphasized it has “no reason to believe that either national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised” while reaffirming its confidence in Jensen as he cooperates with investigation.

❤ 844 · 原帖

The Kobeissi Letter (@KobeissiLetter)

中方称这些指控是“毫无根据的猜测和诽谤”。
英伟达董事会正在进行独立调查。

原文：BREAKING: China officially denies allegations that its intelligence services were involved in the situation with Nvidia, $NVDA, CEO Jensen Huang.
China calls these allegations "groundless speculation and slander."
Nvidia's board is running an independent investigation.

Wall St Engine (@wallstengine)

特朗普谈黄仁勋：
“我还没和他谈过这件事，我只知道他是个好人。你永远不知道发生了什么。我希望一切都好，他干得非常出色。在我看来他是个好人。”
“我认为他是个正直的人，我想他可能有他的理由。你得听听他怎么说。他为国家做出了了不起的贡献。”
特朗普表示，他“当然”会带英伟达（$NVDA）CEO 黄仁勋参加即将到来的亚洲之行，并补充说他没听说黄仁勋做错了什么，“他跟某个人打过交道，但谁不是呢。”

原文：Trump on Jensen Huang:
"I have not spoken to him about it, I just know he's a fine person. You never know what's going on. I hope everything's fine, he's done such an incredible job. He's a fine person in my opinion."
"I think he's an honorable guy, I think he probably has an excuse for it. You have to hear it. He's done an amazing job for the country."
Trump says he’d “certainly” take NVIDIA $NVDA CEO Jensen Huang on his upcoming Asia trip, adding that he hasn’t heard Huang did anything wrong and “he dealt with somebody, but so does everybody else.”

❤ 1,401 · 原帖

The Kobeissi Letter (@KobeissiLetter)

突发：特朗普总统表示，他和司法部曾与“一家大型 AI 公司的领导人”发生过一件事，当时差点“因为他用 AI 干了坏事而把他送进监狱”。
“我们说，准备进监狱吧。去见见你的妻子和孩子，因为明天早上你就要进监狱了，”特朗普说。
特朗普称此人随后“彻底改变了一切”，最终没有被送进监狱。
特朗普拒绝透露此人是谁。

原文：BREAKING: President Trump says he and the Department of Justice had a situation with "a leader of a major AI company" and were about to "send him to jail for doing something bad with AI."
"We said get ready to go to jail. See your wife and children because tomorrow morning you're going to jail," Trump said.
Trump says this person then "totally changed everything" and was not sent to jail.
Trump refuses to specify who this individual was.

❤ 9,291 · 原帖

Jukan (@jukan05)

台湾半导体分析师陆行之（Andrew Lu）对黄仁勋丑闻的看法：
美国为何借丑闻拔刀：三个战略目的
这桩丑闻的目的绝不是揭露一段婚外情，而是要强行推进三个关键目标——这些目标在中美科技战中一直因黄仁勋的反对而毫无进展。
第一刀：彻底摧毁黄仁勋在华盛顿反制裁游说的正当性
过去两年，硅谷反对全面禁止对华芯片出口声音最大、影响力最强的企业领袖就是黄仁勋。他一直对白宫说同样的话：“把中国市场让给华为，最后死掉的只会是美国科技产业。”
但一旦美国情报部门把被点名为黄仁勋婚外情对象的女子定性为“为中国国家安全部工作、试图推动美国放松芯片管制的间谍”，他为放宽管制所做的每一分游说都会被赋予完全不同的政治含义。这就变成了国家安全问题——外国间谍可能利用秘密关系施加影响。
黄仁勋再也无法在国会或白宫为中国市场说一句话。如果他说了，就会被扣上“中了情报圈套还没醒悟”的帽子。
第二刀：推翻对华 H200 出口许可，切断中国空壳公司与东南亚走私网络的联系
看看这两篇报道的时间点。
11 月 8 日，也就是黄仁勋丑闻爆出的同一天，《纽约时报》发表了一篇调查报道：记者亲自走访了数十家获美国商务部批准经手英伟达 H200 芯片的中国公司，北京的新矩阵（New Matrix）就是其中之一。报道称，获准购买芯片的公司的注册地址竟是空无一人的“幽灵办公室”，其中一些公司与美国制裁名单上的实体以及与中国军方有合同关系的企业关系密切。
一篇爆料说，英伟达 CEO 与负责芯片走私的新加坡公司 Megaspeed 的一名女间谍有染；另一篇说，商务部批准购买 H200 的中国公司不过是替中国军方交易的空壳公司。这两篇报道的目的很明确：向特朗普政府和商务部施压，全面撤销或冻结对华 H200 出口许可，并进一步迫使当局彻底整改通过新加坡等东南亚地区第三方运营的数据中心转移芯片的漏洞。
第三刀：通过国会监督和独立调查给英伟达套上国家安全的缰绳
作为全球市值最大的公司和 AI 领域的主导力量，英伟达此前在经营上享有广泛的自主权。但这一事件之后，负责中国、外交和情报事务的三个国会委员会已开始直接审查英伟达内部的安全措施，甚至迫使英伟达董事会成立独立调查委员会，调查公司自己的创始人兼 CEO。
实际上，华盛顿的国家安全体系已经在英伟达董事会内部安插了一只看门狗。从今往后，目标是确保一切——细到英伟达每一颗高性能芯片的最终去向——都严格符合美国国家安全战略。这也意味着，打擦边球、专门针对监管门槛定制规格来发布芯片的空间将不复存在。
结论
“丑闻是一枚准时引爆的雷管，真正的目的是堵住芯片外流的漏洞。”
黄仁勋犯了一个致命错误：在私生活和人际关系上放松了警惕。最终他落入了情报战的教科书式手段——美人计，并因此被拿住把柄。美国国家安全和情报机构毫不留情地利用了他私生活暴露的弱点，结果一举解决了三个棘手问题：英伟达在白宫游说放松对华限制、H200 芯片流入中国空壳公司，以及经由新加坡的走私。
定于 11 月 18 日举行的国会闭门听证会，将是美国认真着手进一步收紧对中国 AI 算力制裁的决定性转折点。

原文：Taiwanese semiconductor analyst Andrew Lu’s take on the recent scandal involving Jensen Huang:
Why the US Seized on the Scandal to Draw Its Sword: Three Strategic Objectives
The purpose of this scandal is by no means to expose an affair. It is to force through three critical objectives that had made no headway in the tech war between the US and China because Jensen Huang opposed them.
The first cut: Completely destroy the legitimacy of Jensen Huang's lobbying against sanctions in Washington
Over the past two years, the loudest and most influential business leader in Silicon Valley opposing a total ban on chip exports to China has been Jensen Huang. He has told the White House the same thing all along: "Cede the Chinese market to Huawei, and the only one that ends up dead is the American tech industry."
But the moment US intelligence labels the woman named as Huang's affair partner "a spy working for China's Ministry of State Security who sought to steer the US toward easing its chip controls," every bit of lobbying he has done for looser controls takes on an entirely different political meaning. It becomes a national security matter, raising the possibility that a foreign spy used a secret relationship to exert influence.
Huang can no longer say a single word in defense of the Chinese market before Congress or the White House. If he does, he will be branded as someone who "fell for an intelligence operation and still hasn't come to his senses."
The second cut: Reverse the H200 export approvals for China and sever the link between Chinese shell companies and Southeast Asian smuggling networks
Look at the timing of the two reports.
On November 8, the very day the Jensen Huang scandal broke, The New York Times published an investigation for which its reporters went in person to dozens of Chinese companies that the US Commerce Department had approved to handle Nvidia's H200 chips. New Matrix in Beijing was one of them. According to the report, the registered addresses of companies approved to buy the chips turned out to be empty "ghost offices," and some of the companies had close ties to entities on US sanctions lists and to firms under contract with the Chinese military.
One exposé says Nvidia's CEO was having an affair with a female spy from Megaspeed, the Singapore company that handled the chip smuggling. The other says the Chinese companies Commerce approved to buy H200s are nothing but shell companies trading on behalf of the Chinese military. The aim of these two reports is clear. They are meant to pressure the Trump administration and the Commerce Department into fully revoking or freezing H200 export approvals for China and, going further, to force a sweeping overhaul of the loophole that let chips be diverted through data centers run by third parties in Singapore and elsewhere in Southeast Asia.
The third cut: Put Nvidia on a national security leash through congressional oversight and an independent investigation
As the world's largest company by market cap and the dominant force in AI, Nvidia has until now enjoyed broad autonomy in how it runs its business. But in the wake of this incident, the three congressional committees responsible for China, foreign affairs, and intelligence have begun examining Nvidia's internal security measures directly. They have even pressured Nvidia's board into forming an independent investigation committee to look into the company's own founder and CEO.
In effect, Washington's national security establishment has planted a watchdog right inside Nvidia's board. From now on, the goal is to make sure that everything, down to where each and every one of Nvidia's high performance chips ends up, conforms strictly to US national security strategy. It also means there is no more room for skirting the edge of the rules or releasing chips with specs specially tailored to regulatory thresholds.
Conclusion
"The scandal was a detonator set off right on cue. The real goal was to plug the holes chips were leaking through."
Jensen Huang made the fatal mistake of letting his guard down in his private life and personal relationships. In the end, he fell into a honey trap, the textbook tactic of intelligence warfare, and was compromised. America's national security and intelligence agencies ruthlessly exploited the weakness his private life had exposed. As a result, they solved three thorny problems in a single stroke: Nvidia's lobbying at the White House to ease restrictions on China, the flow of H200 chips into Chinese shell companies, and smuggling routed through Singapore.
The closed congressional hearing set for November 18 will be the decisive turning point at which the US moves in earnest to tighten its sanctions on China's AI compute even further.

❤ 7,143 · 原帖

Dylan Patel (@dylan522p)

未来 6 个月黄仁勋不会有什么事，这件事在媒体和金融圈基本会平息下去。
但民主党会把他叫到国会，

And hammer him w questions

Jukan (@jukan05)

→ 此前竞选反对数据中心的政客正在表现出合作态度
“需求消失”和“需求因建设速度跟不上而推迟”之间有重要区别。
尽管抛售很猛烈，我在这些评论中没有看到 AI 需求大面积崩塌的证据。

原文：Various commentary from Qualcomm, Arm, to Meta executives this week during the AI selloff:
$LITE CEO: "You had a comment from the CEO of $IREN and I'd second that. There's a massive disconnect in what we're seeing in our demand books.
And what the markets are showing. And yet you're seeing a massive, massive selloff." (Fri, Nov 6)
$AMD CEO CNBC: "We're at the very beginning of the adoption cycle, where people can see where AI and superintelligence will take us"
"We are seeing demand being higher than supply" (Wed, Nov 4)
$ARM CEO regarding a debate whether AI infrastructure spending is about to peak:
"I think in some states where it gets harder, other states may pick it up to make it easier, but I do believe strongly that if the US hesitates in any way shape performance in terms of data center buildout...
"The rest of the world is ready and willing. There is just huge demand for this capacity. And I think globally the US really wants to be able to compete against China. China is not slowing down at all." (Thu, Nov 5)
$APLD CEO: Bank construction lending, project financing and bond markets remain available, although interest rates and credit spreads have risen
"The big risk is delivering on time." "The demand picture is extremely robust." (Mon, Nov 2)
$QCOM CEO: "It's not demand bound. It's a supply bound."
"We're short on wafers, we're short on substrate, we're short on assembly. Everything is short because demand is very, very high."
"I think what the market is reacting to is what is the speed of the compute build out."
$META on political risk: "We did have a governor that won last night who did make data centers a big part of the platform.
Say as soon as we get past the inauguration, let's meet because we don't want to lose this investment in our town. We don't want these jobs to go elsewhere." (Wed, Nov 4)
Even politicians campaigning against data centers are negotiating. But Meta's president also emphasized that starting new US DCs will become more difficult.
TLDR:
-> Extremely bullish commentary from accelerator players, networking, and semi companies
-> DC developers report strong pricing/demand, but increasingly emphasize financing, permitting and execution risks (more cautious)
-> Politicians that previously campaigned against DCs are showing cooperation
There's an important difference between demand disappearing and demand being delayed by the inability to build fast enough.
Despite the severity of the selloff, I'm not seeing evidence of widespread AI demand destruction in commentary.

原文：GOOGLE EXPANDS ITS TPU CHIP LINEUP
$GOOGL is introducing two new specialized versions of its eighth-generation TPU systems, bringing its lineup to four configurations, Bloomberg reports.
The new systems target two increasingly important AI workloads:
1) TPU 8tx: Designed for secure, confidential computing. It pairs with $AMD CPUs to enable chip-level data encryption, targeting government agencies and companies in regulated industries.
2) TPU 8i Max: Combines two TPU chips in a single package for greater computing power and memory capacity. It's designed for AI workloads requiring long context windows, including coding, drug discovery and complex mathematics.
Both are reconfigured versions of Google's existing TPU designs, rather than entirely new chips, and are expected to become available in 2027.
Google is increasingly focusing on specialized AI hardware as customer requirements evolve.
The company also said its entire available TPU supply is already contracted.

item.title: X 早报 · 2026-11-08（周日）
item.content:encoded:
X 早报 · 2026-11-08（周日）

概览

选后政治余波持续：特朗普称民主党以弹劾相威胁是“最高级别的勒索”并要求司法部调查，还邀请 UFC 总裁 Dana White 出任白宫新闻秘书（据 CNN 已婉拒）；中文圈分析米勒接任幕僚长与内塔尼亚胡可能下台。宏观数据好坏参半：Q3 非农劳动生产率年化增 3.5%、单位劳动成本下降，9 月核心资本品出货创纪录、服务器等订单同比增 27%；但 30 年房贷利率 7.18%、购房贷款申请处于历史低位，CBOE 看跌期权单日成交创纪录。本周看 CPI、PPI 与 17 场美联储官员讲话。芯片与存储仍在深度回撤：11 月 5 日低点时美光距高点约 -48%、Sandisk -66%，Q4 跌幅榜几乎全是半导体。多空争论集中在存储长约（LTA）能否在需求下滑时兑现，以及这轮抛售是否只是仓位去杠杆。台积电否认为英伟达研发 3D DRAM。数据中心遭遇地方阻力：俄亥俄 21 项相关地方投票全部失利、全美 41 项中输 40 项，德州候任州长拟暂停新审批；但也有小镇欢迎，SpaceX 计划在亚利桑那建 700 英亩干冷园区。伯克希尔 Q3 回购 96 亿美元并转为净买入。NASA 宣布约 100 亿美元月球着陆与基地合同并开放宇航员招募；马斯克称 Cybertruck 订单远超停产前产能。中文 AI 圈分享视频生成流水线、Colab 图形客户端，以及大规模生成为何最终要租云 GPU。

选后政治：白宫人事与弹劾之争

特朗普下令美国司法部“调查这一犯罪行为”。

想了想川普为何选择米勒代替苏尔西接任幕僚长 ，正常总统在中选失利后都会选择一个温和派来缓和促进联盟、川普反其道行之。可能的缘由有二：

我要对 $NBIS 这样的新云（Neocloud）给出一个逆向观点：估值崩盘之后，这个主题看起来很有吸引力。
因为马斯克的 $SPCX 之所以重押这个满是“会死掉的小鱼”的市场，是有原因的：
在向 $GOOGL 和 Anthropic 出售算力之后，他看到了这门生意的经济性有多诱人。
这体现在他的行动而不是言语上，比如 SpaceX 最近为采购 GPU 进行的 400 亿美元融资。
$AMZN、$MSFT 乃至 $META 也看到了这门生意有多赚钱，正在加速 AI 数据中心建设。
我认为，如果一家新云具备：
- 与 $NVDA 等厂商关系密切，能拿到配额
- 已有签约容量和许可审批
- 资金充足的交易对手，比如超大规模云厂商
- 有吸引力的经济性，比如采购融资做得对（不像 $CRWV 那样背负高额债务利息，除非它们再融资）
那么我认为它们会过得很好……
不过，更大的担忧在于那些刚开始融资或走许可流程的新玩家，因为进入门槛现在已经极高。
在融资方面，从 $IREN 的财报可以看出，上市新云在紧张的市场中适应得非常好：
比如在一份 5 年合约中，GPU 资本开支获得 90% 的预付款。
它们较旧的 H100 GPU 以先前价格的两倍重新签约，签约价格也提高了 12%，这同样反驳了折旧担忧。
如果数据中心建设因许可延误而放缓……对某些公司会远比其他公司更有利。
例如 Rosenblatt 最近的报告称，$NBIS 在密苏里、宾夕法尼亚和南卡罗来纳的主要建设项目风险很小。
在澳大利亚等地的开发商风险可能也更低。
市场也已表明，这种无限算力套利不可能永远持续，因此对通过 ATM（按市价增发）等方式继续为资本开支融资态度谨慎。
但讽刺的是，更紧的融资和假设中更严格的许可，反而会增强老牌新云的竞争优势，
并对新的数据中心开发商形成更宽的护城河。

原文：I'm going to give a contrarian take on Neoclouds like $NBIS and say the theme looks compelling after the valuation crash.
Since there's a reason why Elon's $SPCX is heavily focused on this market full of "guppies" that would die:
He sees how attractive the economics are after selling compute to $GOOGL and Anthropic.
And this is reflected by his actions not words, from SpaceX's recent $40B financing for GPUs procurement.
$AMZN, $MSFT, and even $META also see how profitable the economics are and are accelerating their AI DC buildouts.
I'd argue if a Neocloud has:
- Close relationships with $NVDA + others for allocations
- Existing contracted capacity + permitting
- Well funded counterparties, such as Hyperscalers.
- Attractive economics, such as financing their procurement correctly (not the way $CRWV has with high debt interest unless they refinance).
Then I think they'll do just fine...
However, the bigger worry is more toward newer players starting financing or the permitting process, since barrier to entry has now become extremely high.
For financing, read through on $IREN earnings has shown public Neoclouds can adapt extremely well to tight markets:
As seen with their 90% prepayments for GPU capex on a 5Y deal.
Their older H100 GPUs recontracted at double their previous pricing and 12% higher contracted pricing also point against depreciation fears.
And in the case DC buildouts slow from permitting delays... it heavily favors some over others.
Rosenblatt's recent note for example stated they see little risk with $NBIS primary buildout that was in Missouri, Pennsylvania, and South Carolina.
And there's probably less risk with developers in places like Australia.
Markets have also show this infinite compute arbitrage can't go on forever, hence the reluctance to further finance capex, via things like ATMs.
But ironically, tighter financing and hypothetical restrictive permitting would increase the competitive advantage of established neoclouds.
And create a larger moat against newer DC developers.

第一步：首先RGBMoCap：普通手机/单目实拍视频切入，AI 直接解算 3D 人体网格（SMPL/SMPL-X），零穿戴设备提取骨骼动画。
第二步：骨骼重定向（Retargeting）与对齐。把真人体型平滑映射到目标角色资产，自动解算修复滑步与穿模，输出干净的 3D/ControlNet 控制层。
第三部：MiniMax H3：作为视频生成基座。H3 的动态连贯性和时序物理规律极强，用来扛住大动态、大视角变化，避免动作抽搐崩坏。

郭宇 guoyu.eth (@turingou)

由于我现在在做的几个不同的垂直化个人代理都需要用到图像和视频生成的功能，所以我不得不在中台层面去解决这个问题。然后我发现，相对于 ComfyUI 的云服务的调度能实现更大的自由度，使用 fal 等这种线上的 API 来做，完全就只能根据商业化的逻辑和成本来控制。这其中就是有一个明显的一个差距，你没有办法完全自由自在地生成东西。不是说 R18 加的东西，是所有东西你都没有办法完全自由自在地生成。也就是说，没有一个服务可以做到这种基线，现有的所有图像和视频生成服务似乎都对这个基线的理解各有差异。Claude Code 的办法是通过一些脚本和预剪辑，在导演层面来实现。我不管切换什么样的模型，是 ComfyUI 当中的工作流的模型，还是 fal 等线上的 API 的模型，都可以达到高度的一致化。但做这件事情的前提是，这个 benchmark 需要你有一台本地的机器，来不断地使用导演模型进行反复审阅，才有可能在不同的导演模型在跑这个 benchmark 的前提下，评分达到几乎一致。
所以我发现，其实相比于使用 API 来进行图像和视频生成，如果你有大规模的需求和高度一致化的长篇视频的需求的话，那么租用云 GPU 是唯一不二的选择。

Machina (@EXM7777)

未来十年最有价值的技能：把你的想法表达成机器和人都能完全理解的文字……
因为同样的清晰会让你得到两次回报
> 对 AI 说清楚，你能想到的任何项目都能被做出来
> 对人说清楚，他们会觉得你是一个真正有价值的人
而在注意力经济里，被看作有价值是决定性因素
好消息是……模型和读者需要你提供的东西是一样的：你想要什么、为什么想要、做完是什么样子

原文：the most valuable skill of the next decade: putting your ideas into words both machines and humans fully get...
because the same clarity pays you twice
> say it clearly to AI and any project you can imagine gets built
> say it clearly to people and they see you as someone genuinely valuable
and in the attention economy, being seen as valuable is the dominating factor
the good part... a model and a reader need the same things from you: what you want, why you want it, what done looks like

item.title: X 早报 · 2026-11-07（周六）
item.content:encoded:
X 早报 · 2026-11-07（周六）

概览

选后剧烈抛售后，纳指 100 日内一度涨约 2.4%，芯片股开盘合计回补近 6000 亿美元市值；但 SOX 五日仍跌约 21.8%，波动已逼近互联网泡沫后水平，杠杆 ETF 与看跌期权成交量创纪录。微软据报终止向 Oracle 租用 AI 云算力协议，ORCL 股价再跌约 5%、距高点回撤约 68%；解读多指向旧代 GPU 换代，而非整体收缩 AI 开支。FT 报道称美国官员相信英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋曾与疑似中国国安相关人士有过“恋爱关系”，叠加 H200 对华销售调查，空头叙事从质疑 AI 需求转向管理层八卦。宏观面：9 月职位空缺大增，12 月加息概率升至约 77%；电脑与半导体进口年化首次超万亿美元。SpaceX 则继续推太空算力：据称 2027 年订 6000 机架、目标轨道 1GW，并展望 Q4 营收大增。Anthropic 仍瞄准 11 月中旬 IPO 路演；存储长约（LTA）是否在下行周期仍能锁利润引发业内争论；中文圈则继续讨论光电子/存储投资逻辑与 AI 短剧《持械入宋》。

反弹日：芯片买回与泡沫级波动

The Kobeissi Letter (@KobeissiLetter)

突发：纳斯达克 100 指数日内涨幅扩大至 +2.4%，芯片股开盘合计市值增加近 6000 亿美元。

原文：BREAKING: The Nasdaq 100 extends gains to +2.4% on the day as chip stocks add nearly +$600 billion worth of market cap at the open.

❤ 1,397 · 原帖

The Kobeissi Letter (@KobeissiLetter)

美国半导体股很少如此剧烈波动：
半导体指数 SOX 过去 5 个交易日下跌 -21.8%，这是自 2001 年 9 月 21 日互联网泡沫破裂后以来最大的五日跌幅。
这也是有记录以来第三大的五日跌幅。
即便是 2008 或 2020 年，也没有出现过如此大的五日回撤。
该 ETF 最大的五日跌幅出现在 2000 年 4 月 14 日，为 -27.1%。

背景是中东经霍尔木兹海峡及替代路线的石油流动恢复，同时更多原油在海上停留更久。
船对船转运让石油在油轮上停留更长时间，而拉长的航运路线也增加了在途时间。
与此同时，全球石油进口国从中东分散采购，拉长了航程，使更多原油被困在油轮上。
结果是，更多石油处于在途状态，而非随时可供炼厂使用，尽管出口流量在恢复，近端供应仍被收紧。
油在流，但及时交付正成为瓶颈。

原文：BREAKING: Global crude oil in transit is up to 1.28 billion barrels, an all-time high.
This figure has surged +180 million barrels over the last several weeks.
This comes as Middle Eastern oil flows recover through the Strait of Hormuz and alternative routes, while more crude remains at sea for longer.
Ship-to-ship transfers are keeping oil aboard tankers for longer, while extended shipping routes are increasing transit times.
Meanwhile, global oil importers diversifying away from the Middle East are lengthening voyages, leaving more crude tied up aboard tankers.
As a result, more oil remains in transit rather than being readily available to refiners, tightening near-term supply despite recovering export flows.
Oil is flowing, but timely delivery is becoming the bottleneck.

回应：有人声称台积电将进入存储并颠覆三大存储厂
这说不通。据我所知，台积电这个项目已做了五年多，但若假定他们在做大宗 DRAM 就错了。台积电没有 DRAM IP、没有 DRAM 专利，也没有相关技术。
我认为“3D DRAM”这个词造成了误解。
与业内专家交流后，我认为正确理解台积电进入 DRAM 的报道应是：
台积电早前发表的研究能看出方向。
在 2025 VLSI Symposium 上，台积电展示了基于氧化物半导体的存储技术，单元为一晶体管一电容（1T1C）。目标是把这种存储集成进先进逻辑芯片，给处理器提供低功耗、低延迟缓存。
关键在于存储阵列直接建在逻辑芯片的后道互连层（BEOL）里。传统 DRAM 是单独造一颗芯片。
为了在先进逻辑芯片互连层里做存储阵列，台积电用了氧化物半导体沟道的选通晶体管，以及低温工艺做的电容。
据台积电，集成存储与逻辑的测试芯片工作在 0.75V。数据保持超过 128ms，随机读写周期低于 8ns，耐久性超过 10¹⁴ 次。台积电把它定位为比 SRAM 密度更高、同时保持低功耗与低延迟的处理器缓存。
所以台积电要做的 3D DRAM，是替代 SRAM 的下一代技术，而且不会是大批量。
谁说台积电会做 DDR 或 LPDDR，根本不懂在说什么。

原文：RE: The claim that TSMC will enter memory and disrupt the big three memory makers
This doesn't make sense. As far as I know, TSMC has been working on this project for more than five years, but it would be a mistake to assume what they're building is commodity DRAM. TSMC has no DRAM IP, no DRAM patents, and none of the relevant technology.
I think the term "3D DRAM" is what's causing the misunderstanding.
After talking with industry experts, I believe this is the correct way to read the reports of TSMC entering DRAM.
TSMC's earlier published research gives a good sense of the direction.
At the 2025 VLSI Symposium, TSMC presented a memory technology based on oxide semiconductors, using a cell made of one transistor and one capacitor (1T1C). The goal was to integrate this memory into advanced logic chips and give processors a cache with low power and low latency.
The key feature of the design is that the memory array is built directly into the back end of line (BEOL) interconnect layers of the logic chip. Conventional DRAM is manufactured as a separate chip.
To build the memory array in the interconnect layers of an advanced logic chip, TSMC used select transistors with an oxide semiconductor channel and capacitors fabricated with a low temperature process.
According to TSMC, the test chip, which integrates memory and logic on a single die, operated at 0.75V. Data retention exceeded 128ms, random read/write cycle time was under 8ns, and endurance was above 10¹⁴ cycles. TSMC positioned the technology as a processor cache that offers higher density than SRAM while keeping power consumption and latency low.
So TSMC would be producing 3D DRAM as a next generation technology to replace SRAM. And not in large volumes, either.
Anyone saying TSMC will make DDR or LPDDR has no idea what they're talking about.
